newsitem.title: CYPRUS: CYPRUS REVERSE REPO YIELD STEADY AT 4.44 PCT.
newsitem.headline: CYPRUS REVERSE REPO YIELD STEADY AT 4.44 PCT.

text.p: The average yield on a reverse repo auction of 15-day Cyprus bills was 4.44 percent on Tuesday, unchanged from the last repo auction on August 4.
Bids from commercial banks totalled 12 million pounds ($22 million) for the 20 million pounds worth of bills on offer by the Central Bank of Cyprus. Bills sold totalled 12 million pounds.
The highest accepted yield was 4.47 percent and the lowest 4.40 percent, the central bank said. ($=0.54 pounds)
